from typesystem.base import ParseError
    from typesystem.tokenize.tokens import DictToken, ListToken, ScalarToken
    import pytest

    content = '{"name": "alice", "values": [1, 2.5, true, null], "nested": {"x": "y"}}'
    token = tokenize_json(content)
    assert isinstance(token, DictToken)
    assert token.value == {
        "name": "alice",
        "values": [1, 2.5, True, None],
        "nested": {"x": "y"},
    }
    assert token.start == 0
    assert token.end == len(content) - 1

    scalar = tokenize_json("42")
    assert isinstance(scalar, ScalarToken)
    assert scalar.value == 42
    assert (scalar.start, scalar.end) == (0, 1)

    list_token = tokenize_json(b'["a", "b"]')
    assert isinstance(list_token, ListToken)
    assert list_token.value == ["a", "b"]
    assert list_token.start == 0
    assert list_token.end == 9

    with pytest.raises(ParseError) as exc_info:
        tokenize_json("   ")
    assert exc_info.value.code == "no_content"

    with pytest.raises(ParseError) as exc_info:
        tokenize_json('{"a": }')
    assert exc_info.value.code == "parse_error"
